name: gitlab-ticket-search
description: Search GitLab tickets using a query.
script:
set -e
repo="$PECORE_PROJECT_REPO_OWNER/$PECORE_PROJECT_REPO_NAME"
items=$(encoded=$(jq -nr --arg repo "$repo" '$repo | @uri')
glab api --method GET --paginate "projects/$encoded/issues" --raw-field "search=$PECORE_PARAMS_QUERY" | jq -es '[.[][] | {id: (.iid | tostring), title}]')
printf '%s\n' "$items" | jq -e '{title: "Tickets", body: tojson}'
